name: HighTorque Pi+ (22 DoF)
source: Hamburg Bit-Bots bitbots_main bitbots_mujoco_sim/xml/pi_plus.xml (3b9f0c9) + hand tips, meshes decimated to 30k faces, MIT
notes: Kid-size robot (~0.7 m), used by the Hamburg Bit-Bots in the RoboCup Humanoid Soccer League. The shoulder joints have ref=+-pi/2, so qpos0 has the arms hanging straight down, but the shoulder-roll range ends at +-1.4: the rest has the upper arms ~10 deg out (at the limit) and the elbows bent forward. 'upper_arm' is shoulder yaw, 'thigh' is hip yaw, 'calf' is the knee. No wrist joint; the hand keypoint is a tip body 9 cm below the wrist link.
